title: A Pfaffian Proof and Generalization of a Conjecture of Sun Zhiwei
summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime, let $n=(p-1)/2$, and let $χ=(\frac{\cdot}{p})$, with $χ(0)=0$. For $a\in\mathbb F_p^\times$ define \[ D_a(x)=\det_{1\le i,j\le n}(x+χ(i^2-aj)), \qquad D_a^{(0)}(x)=\det_{0\le i,j\le n}(x+χ(i^2-aj)). \] We prove \[ D_a(0)=0 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad p\equiv 3 \pmod 4 \quad\text{and}\quad χ(a n!)=1. \] For $p\equiv3\pmod4$ we also give explicit Pfaffian-square factorizations of $D_a(x)$ and $D_a^{(0)}(x)$.
